context: A uni student helps a teen friend prep a club concert flyer
purpose: Teach: ポピュラー/弾く/バナー/甲子園/歯医者/カール/楽章/美女

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 蓮さん、軽音部のコンサートのバナー作るの手伝ってくれない？甲子園の試合と日程かぶってて、誰も手伝ってくれないの。
lines.en: Ren, can you help me make the banner for the music club concert? It overlaps with the Koshien game so no one will help.
lines.style: Pleading teen voice, slightly desperate but cheerful, rising tone on the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいよ。で、どんな曲やるの？ポピュラー寄りの選曲？
lines.en: Sure. So what songs are you playing? More popular-leaning picks?
lines.style: Relaxed older-brother university tone, warm and easygoing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、有名な映画の楽章をアレンジしたやつ。あたしがキーボード弾く担当なんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, an arrangement of a movement from a famous film. I'm in charge of playing keyboard.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen, proud but a little nervous about her role.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おお、本格的だね。じゃあバナーの中央にピアノの鍵盤、隅に楽器のシルエットでどう？
lines.en: Oh, that's pretty legit. How about a piano keyboard in the center and instrument silhouettes in the corners?
lines.style: Thoughtful design-suggestion tone, brainstorming aloud calmly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいね！あとボーカルの先輩、めっちゃ美女だから写真も載せたい。髪のカールがすごく綺麗で。
lines.en: Nice! Also our vocalist senpai is a total beauty, so I want to put her photo too. Her hair curls are really gorgeous.
lines.style: Giggly admiring teen, gossipy excited inflection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解。フォントは手書き風がいいかな。あ、明日の午後は歯医者だから、データは今夜送って。
lines.en: Got it. Handwriting-style font would be good, I think. Oh, I've got the dentist tomorrow afternoon, so send the data tonight.
lines.style: Practical scheduling tone, friendly but firm older-friend voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかった、すぐ送る！蓮さん本当に助かるよ、ありがとう！
lines.en: Got it, I'll send it right away! Ren, you're really saving me, thank you!
lines.style: Grateful, bright teen voice, exclamatory and genuine.
